description.en: Plays the full game-over sequence: fades to black, shows the "game over" image, plays the game-over sound, fades screen A back in, waits, shows a final message, fades everything to black again, cleans up, and returns to the title screen.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

examples.case: Default game-over jingle (every real call site in script_clean/ uses this 0-arg form)
